credentials.scope: the venue's own page is public; the CVM holds no credential for this venue

human_steps: the CVM returns the basket and the venue's own deep link; it places nothing
a human telephones the venue or orders in the house and places the order there
a human pays the venue directly (in the house); the CVM never takes payment
a human records the venue's own confirmation (staff name + time) as the receipt

idempotency.on_duplicate: the CVM places nothing, so it cannot double-place; the venue's own telephone record is the authority

payment_authority.authority: the human who places the order, on the venue's own premises

receipt.durable: the venue's own record; the operator log for the manual test
receipt.form: the venue's own confirmation (staff name + time for a telephone order)
